> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Context

This is a scoped follow-up to #1 and the implementation in draft PR #2. The source snapshot is commit `9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8`; it is not a claim that the default branch already contains that work. Coordinate the implementation baseline with PR #2 or its merged successor. Issue creation and the ready-for-agent label do not authorize provider launches, trust/permission changes, audit adoption, billing changes or new spending. Follow the execution host’s current policy and preserve existing evidence.

## Triage evidence

- PR #2 explicitly records no full Council OS answer/judge comparison and keeps second-project operational acceptance open.
- The final hook change passed 1,227 serial tests and 40 helper/profile checks. Those are scoped verification, not this missing live acceptance.

**Redundancy check:** Inspected the parent #1 agent contract, current shipped native workflow, source/proof binding and published validation records. Existing related mechanisms do not satisfy the specific remaining contract below.

**Prior rejection check:** No rejection knowledge base or matching rejection record was present in the inspected checkout. No other follow-up issue existed at triage start.

## Dated source references

- [Current native workflow/outcomes](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/src/pilot/workflow.ts)
- [Shipped first-use contract](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/skills/the-council/references/first-use.md)
- [Dated operational acceptance record](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/docs/qualification/issue-1-validation.md)

The agent-brief comment is the implementation contract. Parent #1 stays open until its independent operational acceptance criteria are met.

<!-- council-triage-followup:second_project -->

**Dependencies:** Blocked by #4, #5, #6. Verify those outcomes and current evidence before dependent runtime execution.

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement
**State:** ready-for-agent, explicitly requested by the maintainer. This means the specification is ready; dependency or runtime gates are not implied to have passed.
**Summary:** Complete live Council acceptance from a second project

**Current behavior:**
Parent #1 remains open and PR #2 is a draft. The implementation has offline/native-boundary coverage and selected startup evidence, but there is no accepted complete live Council run from a requesting project distinct from the installed package. A coordinator-only answer, direct model review or zero-call prerequisite report is not the missing acceptance result.

**Desired behavior:**
Complete the residual live A9/A10 acceptance task for #1 using the shipped entry path, exact configured voter roster and nonvoting judge. Capture genuine reviewer responses, judge comparison, ballots/outcome and positive owned-resource settlement from a second registered requesting project.

**Key interfaces:**

- The shipped Council skill/native launcher, `PilotRequest`, `NativeEvidence`, `runPilot()` and `PilotOutcome`.
- `QualificationProof`, `QualificationCache` and per-role model/route/effort configuration.
- Readiness/review/judge/ballot envelopes and native Run/Task/Dispatch/terminal provenance.

**Acceptance criteria:**

- [ ] Dependency gate: Gemini live qualification, Cursor controls and included-only billing must be satisfied before full-roster inference. Revalidate OpenAI/judge proof and other sources for the actual current scope rather than assuming old proof transfers to project B.
- [ ] Use a requesting project distinct from the installed package checkout and show that all package helpers/configuration resolve from a clean reproducible distribution. Do not initialize Git merely to register a plain folder.
- [ ] Record exact revision, requesting/installed identities, current source/control/policy/catalog evidence, roster, existing billing access, allowance, finite probe/topic budgets, deadline and ownership before inference. Use a new run identifier and future deadline; preserve every previous journal.
- [ ] Use the exact configured OpenAI/Gemini/xAI voters and nonvoting judge, with requested/exposed selection evidence. No provider substitution or silent degraded roster. The original operating-system question may be used as a bounded supplied-text case; content agreement is not required.
- [ ] Collect independent bound reviewer responses, the judge’s actual comparison and the real ballots/outcome. Separate probe/topic calls and initializations; do not fabricate agreement or reinterpret development reviews as Council votes.
- [ ] Demonstrate current-project normal/cancellation qualification and valid-proof reuse through the shipped producer when required. Positively settle all owned workers, descendants, guards, timers, wrappers and terminals.
- [ ] Publish sanitized reproducible evidence and obtain fresh cross-family whole-change/operational review. If prerequisites remain unavailable, retain the exact blocker, leave A9/A10 and parent #1 open, and do not describe a zero-call report as successful live acceptance.

**Out of scope:**

- Reimplementing the broader first-use repair already tracked by #1; this child task addresses its residual operational acceptance.
- Starting/focusing Orca desktop, changing global provider/trust/billing settings, paid overflow or publishing private projects/raw logs.
- Changing voting/judge rules, weakening required controls or solving the OS recommendation as a separate research project.

**Execution and delivery:**
Work against a revision containing the relevant PR #2 implementation. Recheck the current tree and host policy. Supply portable offline coverage and a reviewable change or validation record, with fresh independent review of material work. Required live evidence must use already-authorized, qualified routes and finite declared call/deadline limits. If a required external capability or permission is unavailable, retain a precise blocker and leave operational completion open; do not substitute a diagnostics-only result for the requested behavior. No global settings, accounts, historical artifacts or unrelated work may be changed under this brief.


**Dependencies:** Blocked by #4, #5, #6. Verify those outcomes and current evidence before dependent runtime execution.
